name: Simple Face Wash | Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Gel Wash | 150ml
description:
Simple Kind to Skin Moisturising Facial Wash – 150ml

Gently cleanse and refresh your skin with the Simple Kind to Skin Moisturising Facial Wash. Perfect for daily use, this soap-free face wash removes oil, dirt, and impurities without leaving your skin dry or irritated.

Key Features & Benefits:

Gentle & Hydrating: Enriched with pro-vitamin B5, vitamin E, and Bisabolol to leave skin soft, smooth, and refreshed.

Safe for Sensitive Skin: Free from harsh chemicals, artificial colors, and perfumes.

Dermatologically Tested: Non-comedogenic, ophthalmologically tested, and safe for daily use.

Vegan & Cruelty-Free: PETA-certified, no animal testing, and packaged in 100% recyclable materials.

Manufacturer: Simple
Country of Manufacture: UK
Size: 150ml

Ideal for all skin types, this facial wash ensures clean, nourished, and healthy-looking skin every day.
